sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000153-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Riverbend Physician Alliance 153 on November 3, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 3.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 90%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
